reserves.name: U.S. Treasury bills & cash (M0 eligible collateral)
reserves.issuerOrObligor: M0 permissioned minters and eligible collateral SPVs

reserveReview.rationale: Citrea identifies ctUSD as an M0-minted stablecoin and directs reserve verification to the M0 network. M0 specifies that extensions wrap and unwrap the base M token through SwapFacility at a perfect 1:1 relationship. M0 now exposes only the on-chain-indexed Minter Gateway total: its off-chain CollateralCurrent composition feed was retired in August 2026, as recorded in the adapter comment in worker/src/cron/reserve-adapters/m0.ts. The reviewed composition therefore contains one 100% keyed aggregate classified as other; the former 97.9% tokenized-Treasury / 2.1% cash snapshot is not treated as current. The direct M relationship remains represented by the documented extension path and is not duplicated as a second reserve graph edge. ctUSD-specific underlying positions, custodians, and provider weights are not published by M0.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Current M0 Protocol API on-chain-indexed Minter Gateway total, the M0 extension relationship, and the adapter-level aggregate classification
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The current M0 source exposes the full aggregate total but not its internal cash/Treasury allocation, minter-level provider shares, or ctUSD-specific custody terms; the retired 97.9/2.1 composition is not current.
